name: tree-public-overath-confident-interface-physics
hypothesis: Use a fixed 4:1 AF3-to-interface-energy average only for AF3 ipSAE at least 0.5; elsewhere retain AF3 alone. Energetic discrimination may be useful only after a credible interface is established. 0.5 is a coarse predeclared high-confidence regime, and the secondary weight is one fifth without tuning.
